Strings.webservers.managed.install.title: Install managed Nginx
Strings.webservers.managed.install.message: This installs Nginx from the system package source and lets nginx.service manage start, stop, restart, and startup. RelaxKonOS manages only its own site configuration. Continue?
Strings.webservers.managed.existing.title: Existing Nginx installation found
Strings.webservers.managed.existing.message: An unmarked Nginx installation already exists in the RelaxKonOS-managed directory. You can validate and reuse it, or delete that directory and reinstall. Deletion cannot be undone.
Strings.webservers.managed.existing.cancelled: The existing Nginx installation was kept; no changes were made.
Strings.webservers.managed.uninstall.title: Uninstall managed Nginx
Strings.webservers.managed.uninstall.message: This stops and removes only the Nginx installation and isolated configuration managed by RelaxKonOS. This cannot be undone. Continue?
Strings.webservers.integration.confirmation.mess: This creates a RelaxKonOS-owned remoteos.conf in Nginx's already-included conf.d directory, tests the configuration, and only then reloads Nginx. Existing site configuration is not changed. Continue?

Strings.webservers.runtime.running_hint: Nginx is accepting requests. Use the power control to stop it safely.

Strings.webservers.runtime.unknown_hint: Checking the Nginx runtime state. Use the power control to start it if needed.
Strings.webservers.external.help: External instances can be integrated when eligible. Integration does not take over the process lifecycle.
Strings.webservers.integrated.help: Integrated instances can reload their configuration to apply site changes.
Strings.webservers.acme.help: Adds the /.well-known/acme-challenge/ route to all RelaxKonOS-managed sites. Sites must bind the certificate domain on port 80; then select HTTP-01 (web root) in Certificate Manager.
Strings.webservers.managed.uninstall_hint: Uninstalling stops and deletes the Nginx instance managed by RelaxKonOS.
Strings.webservers.management_hint.integrated: This Nginx instance is integrated. RelaxKonOS can manage site configuration and reload it, but cannot start, stop, or restart an external Nginx installation. Use a managed installation for full lifecycle control.
Strings.webservers.management_hint.managed: This Nginx instance is installed and managed by RelaxKonOS, so full service lifecycle actions are available.
Strings.webservers.management_hint.external: This Nginx instance is not integrated yet. Integrate it to let RelaxKonOS manage site configuration and reload it.
Strings.webservers.management_hint.none: Select an Nginx instance to see available actions.

Strings.webservers.site.column.name: Name
Strings.webservers.site.service_address_tooltip: Open the directory for a static site
Strings.webservers.site.dialog.help: The configuration is validated by Nginx before it is saved and applied. Each field occupies its own line for easier review.
Strings.webservers.site.dialog.name: Site name
Strings.webservers.site.dialog.bindings_batch: Add domains and ports in bulk
Strings.webservers.site.dialog.bindings_batch_he: Enter one item per line or separate them with commas, for example app.example.com:5000. The default port is 80; after generating, edit each item independently. Every domain/IP in this site listens on every entered port.
Strings.webservers.site.dialog.bindings: Domains / IP addresses and listening ports
Strings.webservers.site.dialog.bindings_help: All rows form one Nginx server: every domain/IP is available on every listed port. Disable HTTPS when using an IP address where possible.
Strings.webservers.site.dialog.static_root_help: The site is created in a RelaxKonOS-owned directory. After saving, open it from the Service address column to upload website files.
Strings.webservers.site.dialog.certificate_sourc: Choose a RelaxKonOS-managed certificate above, or select server PEM/CRT/CER certificate files and a PEM/KEY private-key file. A separate key is optional when the certificate PEM already contains it.
Strings.webservers.site.dialog.certificate_file: Server certificate file (PEM, CRT, or CER)
Strings.webservers.site.dialog.private_key_file: Server private-key file (PEM or KEY, optional)

Strings.webservers.problem.site_server_name_requ: Enter at least one domain name or IP address.
